title: Change in SW Supply by 2030
summary: The Aqueduct Water Stress Projections include indicators of change in water supply, water demand, water stress, and seasonal variability, projected for the availability of surface water by 2030 using pessimistic assumptions. https://www.wri.org/aqueduct
description: Aqueduct Water Stress Projections: modeled change in surface water supply by 2030 (CMIP5 GCMs; RCP4.5/8.5, SSP2/3). Referenced from RRGOrg SQL.
credits: Suggested Citation: Luck, M., M. Landis, F. Gassert. 2015. Aqueduct Global Maps 2.1. Washington, DC: World Resources Institute.

title: Asparagus Cold Dormancy Climate Suitability Change from Historic to 2030 (v.2)
summary: Places where crop climate suitability increases by at least 70%, maintains at 70% or more, or drops below 70% from the historic scenario.
description: MAXENT (3.4.1) estimate of the change between historic and projected 2030 suitable climate for asparagus cold dormancy. Environmental descriptors: CHELSA V2.1 BioClim variables 1-19, model GFDL-ESM4 RCP 7, spanning 1981-2010 and 2011-2040 at 30 arcsecond resolution. Referenced from RRGOrg SQL.
